senses.gloss: to keep a liquid in the throat for the sake of lubrication.
units: Tosef. Sabb. XII (XIII), 10 if one has a sore throat, לא יְעַרְעֲרֶנּוּ בשמן וכ׳ he must not lubricate it with oil (on the Sabbath); Ber. 36ᵃ לא יְעָרְעֶנּוּ (Pi. of עָרַע; Ar. יערער׳); Tosef. Ter. IX, 12 יערענו (ed. Zuck. ירדנו?); Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵃ top יערער׳.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:11:2">Koh. R. to IX, 11</cite> (ref. to <he>יקרה</he>, <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:11:2">ib.</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="P01415"><he>עַרְעִיתָא</he> I</cite>) <he>עת היא שפוגעת האדם ומְעַרְעֶרֶת בו וכ׳</he> it is time that strikes man and causes all these things (vicissitudes) to meet him.
